species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 44°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–26 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 44°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–26 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
West wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
